_status: Values are ROUNDED APPROXIMATIONS keyed in by hand from the published tables named in `sources` (not machine-downloaded). Re-verify against Nomis/ONS before using for anything but seeding. Where no joint table exists the sampler conditions in a stated order (see index.mjs header).

sources.S1: ONS Census 2021 (E&W), TS007A Age by five-year age bands, by sex (Nomis) -> `pop`
sources.S2: ONS Census 2021 (E&W), TS021 Ethnic group + custom 'ethnic group by age' (Nomis RM032-style) -> `eth`, `ethLabel`; Inner London LAs aggregate vs E&W -> `prof.eth`
sources.S3: ONS Census 2021, TS004 Country of birth + custom country of birth by ethnic group; TS015 Year of arrival -> `ukBorn`, `cob`, `ukb`
sources.S4: ONS Census 2021, TS030 Religion + custom religion by ethnic group -> `rel`
sources.S5: ONS Census 2021, TS066 Economic activity status + custom economic activity by age by sex -> `act`
sources.S6: ONS Census 2021, TS060 Industry / TS063 Occupation (SOC 2020 sub-major groups, collapsed to 25) by sex and age -> `O` (M,F,y,o columns)
sources.S7: ONS ASHE 2024 (provisional, Oct 2024), Table 14.6a Hourly pay - Gross, by SOC 2020 sub-major group: p10,p25,median,p75,p90 -> `O` (pay column). NLW/NMW April 2024: 11.44 (21+), 8.60 (18-20).
sources.S8: ONS Labour Force Survey: EMP01/EMP02 (employee types), HOUR01 (usual/actual weekly hours), EMP17 (zero-hours contracts), ONS 'Students in work' (LFS) -> `pat`, `ptHours`, `contract`, `sj`
sources.S9: ONS Census 2021, TS003 Household composition (+ custom by age of person), TS054 Tenure, TS051 Household size, TS050/TS052 Occupancy rating for bedrooms -> `hhAge`, `famType`, `ten`, `bed`, `nKids`
sources.S10: ONS Census 2021, TS002 Legal partnership status; ONS 'Families and households in the UK 2021' (living arrangements by age, LAT couples) -> `rs`, `marr`, `lat`
sources.S11: ONS 'Childbearing for women born in different years, E&W' (childlessness, parity) and ONS 'Fatherhood in E&W' (male approximations) -> `childless`, `nkids`
sources.S12: ONS Census 2021, TS037 General health, by age -> `health`
sources.S13: ONS Census 2021, TS067 Highest level of qualification, by age (+ ethnicity gradient from custom table) -> `edu`, `eduMul`
sources.S14: ONS 'Baby names in E&W' (by decade) for first names; ONS/Forebears surname frequency lists and community naming conventions for ethnic pools. Illustrative modest lists, not full frequency tables -> `names`
